memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'What shall I give you?' he asked. 'Don't give me anything,' Jacob replied. 'But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages. And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen.' 'Agreed,' said Laban. 'Let it be as you have said.'" - Gen 30:31-34 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Jacob proposes a wage arrangement with Laban. He will take as his pay only the unusually-marked animals — the speckled, spotted, and dark-coloured ones, which were the minority in a flock. It was a modest request, and Jacob adds a striking line: "my honesty will testify for me in the future." He wants an arrangement so clear that his integrity can be checked at any time.

After years of being cheated by Laban, Jacob desires transparency. Any animal in his possession that did not fit the agreed markings could be counted as stolen. He was inviting accountability, wanting his dealings to be open and above board.

There is something worth imitating here. We should so order our affairs — our work, our money, our commitments — that our honesty can bear inspection. A person of integrity does not fear having their dealings examined, because there is nothing to hide.

The Bible urges us to be careful to do what is right "in the eyes of everyone" (Rom 12:17), and to let our "yes" be "yes" (Matt 5:37). In a world where cutting corners is common, followers of Christ are called to transparent honesty. Live in such a way that, like Jacob's, your integrity can testify for you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Could my dealings bear honest inspection at any time?
2. Where am I tempted to cut corners rather than be transparent?
3. What would it look like to let my integrity testify for me?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, make me a person of transparent honesty, with nothing to hide. Let my integrity bear inspection and bring honour to Your name in all my dealings. Amen.
